comments.value: Constantly changing names is somewhat mitigated by the (30 days?) wait period in between changes. Still, a previous name option would be great.
@{5b1632dbda49382d3a3cf921|full_name}: it's 90 days per name change, even better than 30.
Yeah I have some people who constantly change their name...
its an issue when its someone who maybe does not stick to one avatar or avatar theme. So one day you see a name you dont recognize and an avatar you recognize less

You can now add notes on people. Dunno how someone convinced TCL of it but they did, he was previously entirely against it. It's not as good as the mod was which put the note optionally below the nameplate, it appears above the users bio. You can slap their old names their.

details: As someone who has an expansive friendslist like most VRChat users I as well as others find it annoying either receiving invites from users we dont recognize cause they changed name at somepoint so we question our friendships. I think adding a feature to see the users previous name show up either permanently or temporarily after said name change. Also adding the ability to give friend nicknames is good in case theres someone who constantly changes their name.
title: Name Change Notifications
